summary: TIAA Real Estate Account filed an 8-K reporting that on September 28, 2026, TIAA, on behalf of the Account, entered a note purchase agreement with qualified institutional purchasers for $150,000,000 aggregate principal of 5.84% series F senior notes due September 28, 2031. The notes are unsecured, sold under a private-placement exemption, pay interest semi-annually in March and September, and permit general corporate use of proceeds. Covenants cover leverage, fixed charges, unencumbered leverage, interest coverage and secured debt ratios. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch covenant headroom and change-of-control repayment terms.
